_note: PLACEHOLDER DATA. Design principle (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-11-robot-reaction-bridge-design.md): valence picks the emotion family, arousal picks the intensity (1-3) -- high valence -> HAPPINESS, medium valence -> INTEREST, low valence -> SADNESS. Emotion must be one of the values furhat-emotion-study's EmotionLibrary.getEmotion() actually implements: HAPPINESS, FEAR, SADNESS, ANGER, SURPRISE, DISGUST, CONTEMPT, LOVE, SHAME, INTEREST.
